show.title: Cryptid Campfire
show.description:
Cryptid Campfire explores the strange and unusual creatures that lurk in the shadows. From Bigfoot to Chupacabras we gather around a virtual campfire every week to talk about the beasts and monsters that share our planet.
Visit us at www.cryptidcampfire.com

episodes.title: 207. Florida Trip Recap
episodes.description_html:
Eli shares the story of his recent Sasquatch expedition to Florida in search of the Skunk Ape. From the Everglades to the pan handle, he recounts meeting various researchers and his various strange experiences of the trip. 

Visit us at www.cryptidcampfire.com where you can get yourself sweet Campfire Gear!

Interested in hearing more? Subscribe to us on Patreon and get access to exclusive episodes, wall papers, behind the scenes looks and more!

episodes.title: 137. Hollow Earth
episodes.description_html: Eli, Jasmine and Alex take a deep dive (literally) into the Earth's crust in this episode, exploring all the mysteries of Hollow Earth and fighting off dinosaurs and crazy theories at the same time! Join us, in this thrilling episode featuring UFOs, World War 2 conspiracies, wooly mammoths and much, much more!

episodes.title: 195. A Clockwork Orang
episodes.description_html: In this exciting double feature, the Campfire visits the islands of Indonesia where two humanoid like cryptids are said to roam. First there is the Orang Bati, a flying monkey of sorts that is said to raid villages in the night stealing away the young and old to take them back to their volcanic lair. Then there is the Orang Pendek, the small cousin of the North American Sasquatch that might be related to the real life Hobbit!

episodes.title: 177. Tall Tales #29 Tree Octopus
episodes.description_html: The Pacific Northwest Tree Octopus is a rare cryptid that is mostly in Washington State. It is like a normal octopus but it lives in the trees. Join Eli and Alex as they reveal the secrets of the elusive tree octopus!

episodes.description_html: In the jungles of South America, a big secret is hidden. The Yakumama is a force of nature, said to be Mother Water, she controls the waterways of the Amazon and sometimes wreaks havoc on villages of people. Gather around the Campfire to decipher truth from fiction!

You guessed it, this week the Campfire is the Manticore! This mysterious creature hasn't been sighted for thousands of years, or has it?

episodes.title: 220. The Minnesota Iceman
episodes.description_html: In the late 1960's carnival goers across the United States had a chance to see something incredible... a creature frozen in a block of ice! Could it be evidence of a living Neanderthal or even a Sasquatch? The strange saga of the Minnesota Iceman involved many cryptozoologists of the time including Ivan Sanderson and Bernard Heuvelmans in a quest to uncover the truth about a specimen so strange and so shrouded in mystery that its identity is still debated today! Join Alex, Jasmine and Eli as they try to untangle the never ending web of secrecy that shrouds the mysterious iceblock!!!
